comment: The files model-refresh may rewrite. Anything not listed here is read for context and never edited. Vendor skills are excluded on purpose: see README, 'Why the vendor skills are not owned'.

vendored.comment: Installed from marketplaces or upstream repos. Tracked so a refresh run can name them as skipped rather than silently ignoring them, and so a future update that clobbers a local edit is expected rather than surprising.
